text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Indonesia's President Suharto reassures East Timorese over core issues during visit.
- Singapore Finance Minister Richard Hu unveils new regional stock barometer, the Business Times Singapore Regional Index, and initiatives to internationalise capital market further.
- Foreign companies can now list and trade their shares here in Singapore dollars in order to allow the currency's gradual internationalisation.
- Singapore government plans to launch industrial scale fish farming programme and agribiotech park to provide 40 percent of fish supply.
- Newly launched Business Times Singapore Regional Index will be first local stock index to trade futures contracts on Singapore International Monetary Exchange.
- Three-day settlement period for share transactions will restrict contra-trading while new securities lending and borrowing facility will boost short-selling.
- CM Telecom International, first listing on the stock exchange's Foreign Board, is oversubscribed by more than 3 times with 7.6 million shares in the public tranche.
- Transport-based company Tibs Holdings has joint venture to expand taxi fleet in China.
- Prima Ltd teams up with South Korean LG Group to set up complex of three factories in Vietnam costing about US$100 million.
- Ossia International's plans for listing on the main board will not include World of Sports.
- Listed Comfort Group forms fully-owned subsidiary, Comfort Eurobike, to import and distribute Piaggio scooters.
